summary: Albemarle filed an 8-K reporting entry on October 29, 2026 into a $1.5 billion unsecured revolving credit agreement with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent, maturing October 29, 2031, replacing a terminated prior facility. Borrowings bear variable benchmark plus ratings-based margin and carry a 3.50:1.00 consolidated leverage covenant, step-up 0.50 for four quarters after debt-financed acquisitions above $500 million. Also disclosed are bylaw amendments. This is a routine credit-facility financing, not a special situation; watch covenant headroom and acquisition capacity.
